subject: HelioMed MAP — first-mile acceptance & invoice path (GCP private offer)
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Lin <susan.lin@heliomed.com>, HelioMed Procurement <procurement@heliomed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioMed MAP kickoff — first-mile acceptance & invoice path (GCP private offer)

Hi Susan / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that maps the evaluation milestones to the billing/checkpoint model for the GCP private offer we discussed. High level:

- 2-week technical eval (start: as soon as we provision access) — acceptance criteria and smoke tests listed in the MAP spreadsheet.
- Demo + technical acceptance gate (customer sign-off) — triggers evaluation invoice (one-time, net 30).
- PO raised + committed capacity — triggers commitment invoice and subscription activation.
- Ongoing monthly usage billing thereafter (detailed line items on the invoice include SKU, committed v. burst, and egress where applicable).

Action items for HelioMed: please confirm the procurement contact who will own the PO and the billing address to appear on invoices. If you have standard PO/GL instructions, attach them and we will ensure the invoice fields match.

Attachments: HelioMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + acceptance checklist).

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment call this week to lock the technical acceptance criteria and PO timing? I have openings Wed 1–3pm PT and Thu 9–11am PT.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

---

Date: Thu, 04 Jul 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed MAP kickoff — first-mile acceptance & invoice path (GCP private offer)

Chloe —

Thanks, this is clear and helpful. Quick answers from our side:

- Procurement lead: Tom Baxter (tom.baxter@heliomed.com) — he will own the PO.
- Finance note: invoice should list Redwood Inc. Tax ID 12-3456789 and our billing address (will confirm below).
- Compliance: we’ll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short note on network isolation for private offer deployment (VPC peering requirements).

We usually ask that the MAP include an explicit rollback plan and an SLA fallback in case the private offer region experiences degraded capacity. Can you add a short section?

I’ve attached our standard PO template for your finance team to review (Procurement_Template_heliomed.docx).

We can do Wed 10am PT next week for the alignment call.

Best,
Susan Lin
Director, Platform Engineering | HelioMed
susan.lin@heliomed.com

Date: Sun, 07 Jul 2029 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed MAP kickoff — technical acceptance details & rollback

Susan —

Appreciate the questions. A few clarifications on the technical acceptance and rollback language so procurement and engineering have a single source of truth: 

1) Acceptance tests (examples to be executed during the 2-week eval):
   - Sample inference vectors (we’ll provide a set of 25 test prompts) — correctness thresholds per class (F1 > 0.85 where applicable).
   - Performance: expected p95 latency < 150ms for typical sequence lengths (we can add a waiver for occasional heavy sequences).
   - Stability: no more than 2 infra-related errors during a 48-hour rolling window for the demo environment.

2) Rollback / fallback: if private offer capacity is degraded beyond acceptable SLOs we will:
   - Temporarily route affected traffic to an equivalent hosted model variant (same model family) for up to 72 hours while we remediate.
   - Notify HelioMed via the incident channel and provide a remediation ETA; remediation steps and teleconference cadence are in the attached test plan.

3) Private offer / billing note: Redwood will provision the private-offer SKU on GCP and provide line-item invoices referencing the PO number you supply. The evaluation invoice will be issued after technical acceptance and will be net 30. Commitment invoices are issued on activation of the reserved capacity.

I’ve attached the Redwood_SOW_heliomed_v2.pdf and a short test-plan excerpt. Happy to walk through the test vectors on Wed 10am PT.

—Jordan
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Subject: Billing flow & PO details for HelioMed (MAP milestones)

Tom / procurement team —

Looping in the billing route so finance has the expected invoice milestones and PO notes. Summary of the billing flow tied to the MAP: 

1) Evaluation invoice — issued after customer technical acceptance and demo sign-off. Net 30.
2) Commitment invoice — issued on activation of committed capacity once PO is received. This invoice will reference the PO number and detail the committed SKU / reserved hours.
3) Monthly usage invoices — standard monthly cycle (detailed usage line items, adjustments for burst).

Please confirm:
- Billing address to appear on invoices (legal / AP contact): HelioMed, Attn: AP — (please paste full address)
- PO number format and any GL/Cost-center fields we should include on the invoice line items.
- Do you require a single consolidated invoice across subsidiaries or separate invoices per legal entity?

Attachments: PO_template.docx (filled example would be helpful).

DocuSign preference: we can send the MAP + SOW via DocuSign (default) or provide a PDF for your signature team. If DocuSign, please confirm the signer name and preferred email.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: HelioMed MAP kickoff — first-mile acceptance & invoice path (GCP private offer)

Hi all —

We reviewed the MAP and the SOW with our engineering and finance leads. We can confirm the following:

- Procurement timeline: we expect to issue a PO by 2029-07-15. Finance will use the PO_template.docx you provided and include the Redwood Inc. tax ID.
- Billing address (AP contact): HelioMed, Accounts Payable, 2300 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401, Attn: AP Team.
- Acceptance tweak: engineering requests a relaxed p95 latency threshold for heavy sequences — change allowed up to 200ms for sequences > 2k tokens during the eval window. We accept the rollback & hosted-variant fallback plan.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report request — we will accept a scoped SOC 2 statement and the network isolation note you mentioned.

Attached: HelioMed_MAP_v1_filled.xlsx (MAP with our acceptance checkboxes) and a draft PO form (PO_heliomed_4571_filled.docx). Please confirm you can generate the evaluation invoice post-demo and that line items will reference PO_4571.

We’ll be on the alignment call Wed 10am PT. Thanks for the quick turn.

Best,
Susan
Director, Platform Engineering | HelioMed
